quarterly_data.signal: KLA's 10-Q: significant purchase commitments, primarily for material, services, supplies and asset purchases, were approximately $4.83 billion as of March 31, 2026, a majority due within the next 12 months. KLA says a few large suppliers have discontinued manufacturing certain DRAM chips incorporated in a number of its products; the resulting shortage caused a dramatic increase in prices for these chips, its efforts to procure them contributed to an increase in purchase commitments in fiscal 2026, and it expects the additional DRAM costs to continue to weigh on gross margin in calendar 2026.
